scope: Restore Publish 14.1 crafting Luck as a bounded luck plus force_luck skill-modifier roll in assembly and experimentation, and fail closed the retained NGE generic lucky-proc ABI for non-crafting consumers.

findings: Publish 14.1 assembly and experimentation add a random value bounded by the sum of the luck and force_luck skill modifiers to the ordinary crafting roll.
The authenticated crafting path does not derive Luck from a visible player combat level and does not read the later luck_modified expertise statistic.
Crafting Luck feeds the normal success bands; it does not create the retained NGE generic lucky critical-success proc.
The retained generic lucky helper also feeds later healing, junk-fencing, channel-heal, and theft proc behavior, so its ABI is retained but fails closed outside the authenticated crafting path.
